messages:
sara-support: Customer reported they can't start free trial because card-on-file 3DS challenge keeps failing. They see an error on checkout: `payment_intent.confirm` returns 402 with `three_d_secure_required` and the 3DS flow times out. Customer tried twice with different cards. They want trial credits now — blocker for onboarding.
eli-se: can you paste the raw payment response and customer email? also which region (us/eu)?
sara-support: email: maya+trial@startupco.com, region: eu-west-1. Raw response snippet from our logs: ```{
  "status": "requires_action",
  "next_action": {
    "type": "use_stripe_sdk",
    "redirect_to_url": {
      "url": "https://3ds.auth/flow/..",
      "return_url": "https://redwood.app/checkout/return"
    }
  },
  "error": {
    "code": "three_d_secure_challenge_timeout",
    "message": "Challenge timed out after 120s"
  }
}```
eli-se: thanks. That error looks like the issuer is dropping the challenge. Could be bank/3DS provider latency. Any Sentry/trace id?
sara-support: trace_id: tx_0b9f3e9d. User says their bank popped a 3DS modal but it never finished, then browser returned to checkout with a cancelled state. They tried Chrome and Safari.
nina-billing: we can do a manual trial grant for them. Need the account id and confirmation that they passed our KYC check (we have their workspace sign-up details). sara — can you confirm workspace id?
sara-support: workspace: startupco-45, they passed email verification and no spam flags.
nina-billing: ok i'll apply a 14-day trial credit manually and note the payment intent failed due to issuer 3DS. putting a hold on auto-billing for 30 days. tagging internal ticket.
chris-oncall: fyi payments-bot is showing elevated 3DS challenge timeouts for eu region in last 2h — not a full outage but spike. payments-bot: ALERT: region=eu-west-1 metric=3ds_challenge_timeout rate=4.7% (baseline 0.6%)
eli-se: we should add a fallback: if payment fails with challenge_timeout and user hasn't completed, allow manual trial flow for low-risk accounts, and enqueue a follow-up to re-attempt tokenization without requiring 3DS when allowed by regulations. I'll open an RFC.
sara-support: did nina finish the manual grant? customer said they're unblocked.
nina-billing: done — credited 14-day trial (internal note #INC-9872). I messaged the customer and waived immediate card requirement.
sara-support: they confirmed in chat, thanks. Closing on customer side.
chris-oncall: created infra ticket PAY-3345 to investigate 3DS provider latency and add better retries. Also added a temporary dashboard alarm to detect >1% 3DS timeouts.
eli-se: thanks team. Action items: nina applied manual credit, chris owning PAY-3345, i'll draft RFC for fallback flow. sara — please paste thread id to the customer ticket and mark resolved. :thumbsup:
